parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
In the alpha-particle scattering experiment, alpha-particles were directed at a thin gold foil.

State what may be inferred from:
parts.text: the observation that most alpha-particles pass through the foil

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: the observation that some alpha-particles are scattered through angles greater than $90^{\circ}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A proton and an alpha-particle are moving in the same uniform electric field.

Determine the ratio

$$\frac{\text{acceleration of proton due to the electric field}}{\text{acceleration of alpha-particle due to the electric field}}.$$
